order_note: Predecessor SQL 130 (applied to staging and production on 2026-10-30): the API counts every authenticator-code check next to SQL 130's code_check rate limit, so the engine refuses SQL 132 (predecessors_applied) until consume_financial_totp_rate_limit is at SQL 130's intended state. SQL 132 creates one new function, financial_totp_count_code_check(uuid), on the financial TOTP enrollment schema created on the AWS databases from aws/migrations/proposed/NOT_APPLIED_20260911_financial_totp_enrollment.sql (on no release key). The spec prerequisites are financial_totp_enrollments with application_user_id, failed_attempts and locked_until, financial_totp_mark_verified(uuid, bigint) (the reset path, unchanged), auth.uid() and role checksops; a read-only production inspect confirms them. The applying login must be able to write financial_totp_enrollments as the function's owner (definer_can_write_relations: the table owner without FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, or a superuser or BYPASSRLS). Expected pre-state in both environments: the function absent (release sql132 v1 / function public.financial_totp_count_code_check(uuid): absent). Where it already exists (a re-run) it must be owned by the applying login (functions_owned_by_login), keep its TABLE result (function_results_match) and hold no EXECUTE grant other than checksops and the owner, which the file keeps, and PUBLIC, which it revokes (function_acl_replaceable). The ACL after the apply is checksops and the owner. The API change that calls the function (aws/functions/api/auth-financial-totp.mjs and providers/production/checkalt-register.mjs, this change) tolerates its absence (no count, no lockout, never a 500) and needs the guarded Lambda path after this pin is applied in that environment; no API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin. Adds no trigger.
